lines.x: Hm? You want to watch me forge weapons? Sure, but be careful not to get singed.
Only weapons that don't see use go undamaged. Therefore, a spotless weapon is actually a terrible sacrilege.

Nowadays, weapon and equipment manufacturing is all modernized. Traditional craftsmen lose their livelihoods because of it. Times change. Those who can't keep up get left behind... that's only natural.
Firearms… these weapons will change the world completely.
My right leg? Oh, It's no big deal. You know, all craftsmen make mistakes.
Thank you for giving me a chance to show what I can do.
You saw my name engraved on some equipment? Well, no need to mind that. Probably has nothing to do with me.
Steel and bronze form the bone, and then…
If me and my hammer can still be of use to you, I'm honored.
They're promoting new drinks at the bar... What should I have today?
Vulcan, that's what everyone calls me. I can do maintenance on your weapons, if it comes up. The equipment I need for the forge is listed here, in this blueprint.
Hmm… I'm feeling inspired. Gotta start the blowers. It's time to work.
A skilled craftsman is crucial to a military organization. I see you understand that well.
Keeping your weapons in good condition is the best way to keep your people safe. You agree with me? Seems I made the right choice joining you.
I just want to focus on my work.
You're making me the leader…? If you insist… Still, I'm much better at designing and producing weapons than giving orders.
Can I stay behind and work? No?
Hopeless imbeciles...
Yes?
Hmm?
I'm on it.
Ready and waiting.
Armed up!
Let the fires rage!
I don't need healing.
Your weapon will shatter under my next blow!
Please bring me any enemy equipment you find. I want to know what they're making now.
A victory, just as planned! This is why we need high-quality equipment for our fighters.
Please submit damage reports for all of your equipment. I'll work on repairs when we get back.
My skills are still lacking…
Do you have a furnace here?
Argh...
Any equipment you have in mind? I can try making it for you.
Arknights.
Happy New Year, Doctor. A moment please, I'm working the forge. In our trade, we believe that the flames must burn bright over the new year, so that we'll be able to craft strong equipment.
Good morning, Doctor.

Happy birthday, Doctor. I'm not precisely sure what to give you as a present, since you don't need weapons. But the bar has been mixing some new drinks lately, and they've still got the ones I like. So how about I buy you a drink?

People at Rhodes Island are beginning to understand the wonders of weapons. I was used to being alone, but now I get a few regular visitors... not that I mind. It's kind of fun, actually. Sometimes I even feel like a few more would be nice.
